names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ερμάς, Πατρόβας, Λίνος, Γάιος και Φιλόλογος, Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Святитель Гаий, епископ Ефесский, апостол от 70-ти», with the rank words and the see left off; the see is recorded as the office. The line itself gives the name in the genitive.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 5. новембар ст. ст., „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“ — «Св. апостоли» left off, and the heading gives the five nothing but five bare names in the nominative, so the fourth of them is the whole of the form (section 6). The book writes the Serbian ј where the Russian form this folder already stores writes «Гаий»; copied as printed and never bent towards the other book. `sr-foldpred.mjs` reports it adds no new fold key, the folded string being three letters and below the four `nameKeys` requires.

feast.note: The name page also lists «4 января (70 ап.)», the synaxis of the Seventy Apostles, which is a synaxis and not a second feast; this folder renders on 5 ноября ст. ст. only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 ноября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ερμάς, Πατρόβας, Λίνος, Γάιος και Φιλόλογος, Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 18.11.2025 (5. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли: Патров, Ерма, Лин, Гај и Филолог.“

attestations.note: The fourth name of the day’s second entry, an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF FIVE with no «и други» at the end, so all five folders take the same one heading, whole, with its closing full stop. URL year 2025. `types` AND `office` UNTOUCHED AND THE TWO BOOKS AGREE ON HIS SEE: «Гај у Ефесу (Рим. 16, 23)», bishop in Ephesus, which is the Bishop of Ephesus already in `office`, and the reference is correct as printed. «Св. апостоли» is the `apostle` and «Беху из седамдесет апостола» the Seventy. `dates` UNTOUCHED at the first century: no year at all. NO `locations`, NO `related` ROW: the other four are `related` here in both directions already. NO FOLD: «Гај» folds to three letters, below the four the gate’s `nameKeys` requires, so it makes no key — and it is a different string from the Russian «Гаий» this folder already stores, which is worth saying because a reader comparing them by eye would read them as the same name spelled two ways, and they are. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: The century days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 5 ноября ст. ст., «Апп. от 70-ти Патрова , Ерма , Лина , Гаия , Филолога (I).». Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave this folder any year, so this is the first date it carries.
